eval_dimensions.name: Install-Method Selection Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When UV is not installed, the skill presents ranked install methods via AskUserQuestion (system package manager > pipx > standalone installer > curl, filtered to available prerequisites) and never executes the install command itself.

evals.name: Missing UV fires the install-method AskUserQuestion
evals.description: When check-uv.sh exits 1 (UV missing), the skill fetches the install docs, then presents ranked install options via AskUserQuestion rather than picking one and running it.
evals.input: /Dev10x:py-uv (check-uv.sh exits 1: UV not installed, pipx available)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion presents ranked install methods after the WebFetch of the installation docs
No inline 'Install with pipx?' text substitutes for the tool call

evals.name: The skill never executes the install command itself
evals.description: Regardless of which option the user picks, the skill tells the user the exact command and waits for them to run it — it never invokes an installer directly via Bash.

assertions.signal: No Bash call runs 'pipx install uv', 'curl ... | sh', or any other install command; the skill only re-runs check-uv.sh after the user confirms

evals.name: Options are filtered to available package managers
evals.description: An install method whose prerequisite tool (e.g., pipx, a system package manager) is not present in the detected PACKAGE_MANAGERS output is not offered as an option.
evals.input: /Dev10x:py-uv (UV missing, pipx NOT available, curl available)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion options exclude pipx and include only methods whose prerequisite was detected

evals.name: UV already installed and scripts migrated skips the gate entirely
evals.description: When check-uv.sh exits 0, the skill reports success and stops without ever presenting the install gate.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called; the skill reports 'UV installed, all scripts migrated' and stops

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the py-uv skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to check/install UV or migrate scripts

should_trigger.query: set up uv for the first time on this machine
should_trigger.rationale: First-time UV installation — the core use case

should_trigger.query: convert this script's shebang to PEP 723
should_trigger.rationale: Migration of a legacy shebang script

should_not_trigger.query: uv is already installed, just run the tests
should_not_trigger.rationale: UV already configured — no setup work needed

should_not_trigger.query: write a new Python package with a pyproject.toml
should_not_trigger.rationale: Standard package, not a standalone uv script
